title: Pope calls worshippers ‘saints of France’ after AI warning

blocks.text: PARIS, France — Thousands of worshippers cheered Pope Leo XIV on Friday as he stepped up to pray and called those gathered at a stadium near Paris the “saints of France”, after urging world peace and warning against an AI-driven “paradise of machines”. “The Church of France needs you,” he told the worshippers, who were aged between 17 and 35. “Thank you for your courage, thank you for your presence, thank you for your faith.” “You are the saints of France,” he added, after golden fireworks exploded above the Stade de France following a reenactment of the country’s Christian history.
